description: Searches buyable media placements by budget, authority, geography, topic and link policy. Returns offers with a fixed USD price, turnaround, link disclosure and a stable id that quote_placements accepts. max_price filters the catalogue to a budget.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "US".

indexed.description: Only outlets whose placements are confirmed indexed by Google.

max_price.description: Maximum USD price per placement. Use the buyer budget.

region.description: North America, Europe, Middle East, Latin America, Asia Pacific, Africa, Oceania or Global.

name: search_outlets
title: Search media outlets
